variants.name: Gap features
variants.method: Exact gap and landing observations (60 inputs)

variants.name: Two-tick decisions
variants.method: Gap features + decisions every two physics ticks

variants.name: Curriculum
variants.method: Gap features + gradually harder training courses

variants.name: Lower learning rate
variants.method: Gap features + learning rate 0.0001 instead of 0.0003

variants.name: Larger fruit bonus
variants.method: Gap features + training fruit bonus 4 instead of 2

variants.name: Combined methods
variants.method: Gap features + two-tick decisions + curriculum + lower learning rate + fruit bonus 4

limitations: Two-tick runs use twice as many decisions and gradient updates for a comparable nominal physics budget
The original baseline was resumed during its historical training run
Rewards in the fruit-bonus training logs differ; test rewards always use the original formula
